title: Inventory Count Authorization Form
subtitle: Warehouse Inventory Count: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Inventory Count Authorization Form binds item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance to a named transport decision, commercial or operating limit, effective time, and the inventory control authority's confirmation. The inventory control coordinator records the requested Warehouse Inventory Count action and keeps any variance outside the granted authority.
use_case: Use Inventory Count Authorization Form at warehouse zone, bin, staging location, quarantine area, and system record. Reconcile applicable Warehouse Inventory Count requirements with the load, carrier, rate, claim, equipment, document, or inventory boundary that applies. Capture the inventory control authority's approval, counteroffer, hold, or decline, then reauthorize any change to item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance.

sections.title: Requesting party, authority, and source record
sections.guidance: For Warehouse Inventory Count, identify responsible parties, warehouse zone, bin, staging location, quarantine area, and system record, and the linked item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance source.

fields.label: Item, lot, serial, unit, and location
System snapshot, freeze time, and prior transaction reference

sections.title: Requested scope, limits, and decision lines
sections.guidance: Capture Warehouse Inventory Count facts for item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Warehouse Inventory Count authorization checks
items: Recent receipt, pick, transfer, or adjustment
Variance cause, hold, approval, and posting

sections.title: Authorization conditions and final decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Warehouse Inventory Count conditions; have inventory control coordinator assign the next Warehouse Inventory Count owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Warehouse Inventory Count when identity, count integrity, variance basis, approval, or verified posting remains unresolved. Retain the available Warehouse Inventory Count proof and route unresolved item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance scope to inventory control coordinator.
